subject: Temporary invoice-only onboarding path for Peregrine Labs (pilot) — approval needed
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@peregrine-labs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@peregrine-labs.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot onboarding — invoice routing request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week — the Peregrine team is keen to start the 8-week pilot next Monday. Quick heads-up on procurement: our internal procurement team is constrained for pilots and they asked whether Redwood can accept invoices without a PO for this short pilot.

What we can commit to:
- Pilot commitment: up to $9,500 total over 8 weeks
- We can provide expedited payment (Net 30) once invoices are issued
- We can return a signed short SOW and W-9 today if that helps

Is there a temporary invoice-only path you can approve for pilots under $10k? If so, please confirm any required paperwork (insurance, W-9, SOW) and where to send the invoice. I attached the W-9 and a placeholder invoice.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Meyers
Head of Applied ML, Peregrine Labs
[jordan.meyers@peregrine-labs.com]

Attachments: Peregrine_W9.pdf (pdf), Peregrine_Invoice_May2027.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot onboarding — invoice routing request

Laura / Aditya — forwarding Peregrine's ask. They want a temporary invoice-only onboarding path for a small pilot (<= $10k) and will provide a signed short SOW + W-9. Can Finance or Vendor Ops confirm if we can accept invoices without a PO for this case and what guardrails we need (limits, required docs, payment terms)?

Key context:
- Account: Peregrine Labs, pilot up to $9.5k
- They can sign SOW and provide W-9 today (attached)
- They prefer Net 30 payment once invoice is submitted

If we need a one-time exception record or approval, happy to collect the signatures. Would like to avoid delaying start.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot onboarding — invoice routing request

Marcus / Aditya,

We can support a controlled invoice-only path for pilots under certain conditions. Finance's comfort level is tied to vendor verification and spend caps. Proposed guardrails:

1) Temporary cap: max $10,000 total for the pilot period (must be in writing).
2) Required documents before first invoice: W-9, signed short SOW describing scope/dates, and certificate of insurance or confirmation of commercial general liability (if they are doing any on-prem work).
3) Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date; standard remittance instructions will be used.
4) Exception approval: VP-Finance or delegated approver signs an "Invoice-only Pilot Exception" form. Finance will record the exception in the vendor system and set an expiration date (pilot end + 30 days).
5) Reconciliation: Weekly check-ins between Sales and Finance if invoices are staggered.

If Vendor Ops (Aditya) confirms no further procurement-level hurdles, I can sign off on the exception and provide the remittance address. We will not process invoices over the $10k cap without a PO.

Let me know if you want me to draft the exception memo; otherwise I can sign the template once Vendor Ops confirms.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

[Attachment: temporary-sow-peregrine.docx referenced for signature]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Meyers <jordan.meyers@peregrine-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot onboarding — invoice routing request

Thanks all — Vendor Ops has reviewed Peregrine's vendor record and the attached W-9. A couple of operational notes before we finalize the exception:

- We will create a temporary vendor ID and flag their account as "Pilot - Invoice Only" in the vendor portal. That flag prevents purchase orders from being created and restricts payment to the amounts on the recorded invoices until the exception expires.
- Please upload the signed short SOW to the vendor record (I attached a draft SOW link; happy to iterate).
- Admitted insurance is preferred but not mandatory for remote pilots; if we escalate to on-prem or data access requiring higher risk, we will require COI.
- I will draft the brief exception memo (one paragraph + approval box) and send to Laura for signature. Once Laura signs, Finance will provision the temporary vendor ID and provide remittance instructions.

Jordan — please: send the signed SOW back to me and cc finance@redwoodinference.com. After Laura signs the exception memo we will accept invoices up to $10k under this pilot.

Marcus — if you're good with this flow I will start the vendor ID and prepare the memo.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Vendor Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
